clue.text: Expression of displeasure or distraction

clue.text: Having to do with class correction

parts.note: re means concerning, having to do with

clue.text: Working rate in exposed situation

as can mean for, in the role of

clue.text: An officer of the law studies the record

a table is a list or record of data

clue.text: Handy little tools

clue.text: Article on travel in time gone by

clue.text: A propeller, or a substitute for it

to shy is to throw, the same as cast

clue.text: When one's absorbed in a weighty book break up can result

one is I, and one's read as 'one is' gives I plus S

clue.text: Leave a musical group with no backing

clue.text: Bustle about in artful fashion

clue.text: One in a position to get fish

clue.text: Locked up in Capri's only jail

indicators.note: the answer is enclosed within the letters of the island phrase

clue.text: She'd suit anybody!

clue.text: Pooled resources-formed a ring
